name: Honoring Your Father And Mother
overview: Scripture commands children to honor and obey their parents as a fundamental duty, emphasizing this as a righteous act that brings blessing and longevity, as seen in Exodus 20:12 and Ephesians 6:1. Jesus highlights the importance of adhering to God's commandments over human traditions, reminding believers that honoring parents is not merely cultural but a divine mandate (Matthew 15:3). Together, these verses affirm that honoring one’s father and mother is central to living in obedience to God and receiving His favor.
